description: This file contains performance tests for disk cache components in Chromium, including timing of cache writes and reads, block file operations, and index eviction performance.

classes.name: DiskCachePerfTest
classes.description: Performance test suite for disk cache components, including timing of cache operations and index eviction performance.

classes.name: WriteHandler
classes.description: Handles concurrent writing of cache entries during performance tests.

classes.name: ReadHandler
classes.description: Handles concurrent reading of cache entries during performance tests.

methods.name: TimeWrites
methods.description: Measures time taken to write multiple cache entries.

methods.name: TimeReads
methods.description: Measures time taken to read cache entries, either headers only or headers and body.

methods.name: CacheBackendPerformance
methods.description: Runs performance tests on cache backend including write/read timings.

methods.name: ResetAndEvictSystemDiskCache
methods.description: Resets cache and evicts system cache files.
